description: FastAPI route definitions for managing robot test files, including upload, retrieval, update, deletion, and analysis of required variables for test cases.

methods.name: _decode_robot_file_content
methods.description: Decodes robot file content bytes with robust encoding detection, trying UTF-8, charset-normalizer, and fallback to UTF-8 with replacement.

methods.name: upload_test_file
methods.description: Handles uploading a robot test file, validating, parsing, storing in MinIO, and creating database records, with duplicate path handling.

methods.name: list_test_files
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all robot test files.

methods.name: get_test_file
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific test file by ID.

methods.name: update_test_file
methods.description: Updates the name and description of a test file.

methods.name: delete_test_file
methods.description: Deletes a test file and all associated data, including storage cleanup.

methods.name: get_testcase_required_variables
methods.description: Analyzes a specific test case within a robot file to determine required input variables, supporting both ID and UUID identifiers.
